The material is fully physical and has no other logical properties. It is pure physical input, shared by inputs that can also be processed by input processors, such as hardlink/symlink, hash/sha, and bit_split, but is not used for processing.

It is not even possible to manipulate this material. It cannot be changed, erased, or updated. It is pure physical input.
